description: This file defines the 'StreamingContext' class for Spark Streaming in PySpark, providing methods to create, manage, and control streaming data pipelines, including deprecated DStream functionality.

classes.name: StreamingContext
classes.description: Main class for Spark Streaming functionality, managing streaming contexts, starting/stopping streams, and handling checkpointing and serialization.

methods.name: getOrCreate
methods.description: Recreates or creates a new StreamingContext from checkpoint data or via a setup function.

methods.name: getActive
methods.description: Returns the currently active StreamingContext if one exists.

methods.name: getActiveOrCreate
methods.description: Returns the active StreamingContext or creates a new one if none exists, possibly from checkpoint.

methods.name: awaitTermination
methods.description: Waits for the streaming computation to terminate.

methods.name: awaitTerminationOrTimeout
methods.description: Waits for termination or a timeout, returning a boolean indicating if it stopped.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the streaming context, with options to stop SparkContext and do so gracefully.

methods.name: remember
methods.description: Sets the duration for which RDDs generated by DStreams are remembered.

methods.name: checkpoint
methods.description: Sets the directory for checkpointing the streaming graph.

methods.name: socketTextStream
methods.description: Creates a DStream from TCP socket data.

methods.name: textFileStream
methods.description: Creates a DStream by monitoring a directory for new text files.

methods.name: binaryRecordsStream
methods.description: Creates a DStream from binary files with fixed-length records.

methods.name: queueStream
methods.description: Creates a DStream from a queue of RDDs.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Creates a new DStream by applying a transformation function to existing DStreams.

methods.name: union
methods.description: Unifies multiple DStreams of the same type and slide duration.

methods.name: addStreamingListener
methods.description: Adds a listener for streaming system events.
